newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB predicts 2.1 bln peso full year net.
newsitem.headline: PNB predicts 2.1 bln peso full year net.

text.p: Philippine National Bank (PNB) said on Wednesday it expects net profit for 1997 to reach 2.1 billion pesos, up from 1.71 billion a year earlier.
"I am confident we can hit this target despite the situation," bank president Peter Favila told reporters, referring to the recent de facto peso devaluation and high interest rates.
The bank earlier reported first half net profit of 955 million pesos compared with 701 million in the same period last year.
However, senior vice-president Emerita Diaz, said the first half figure was slightly below target.
"We are less than 100 million pesos below," she said.
The first half net includes a 163 million peso profit from the sale of assets.
